scenarioDescriptions.Home_Cook_with_Pip: A first-time household sees the pantry next step alongside the dashboard actions.
scenarioDescriptions.Inventory_Receipt_Intake_Entry: Inventory navigation opens the existing receipt intake scanner.
scenarioDescriptions.Inventory_Quick_Add_Minimal: Manual Quick Add accepts identity, an explicit unit, and quantity while leaving advanced fields available.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Purchased_Pantry_Review: Purchased groceries require explicit add or exclude decisions before pantry review is confirmed.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Preview_Review_Required: Uncertain food-safety information remains visible before shopping confirmation.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Preview_Blocked: A known food-safety conflict blocks shopping confirmation.
